name: Agentbox
description: An inbox for Claude Code and Codex agents, each working in its own git worktree.
changes: First catalog release: browser UI, private workspace access, persistent state, Claude Code and Codex preinstalled.
notes: Sign in to Claude Code or Codex from Agentbox. Their subscriptions and usage are separate from hosting.
The app and its coding-agent accounts are shared by workspace members who can open it.
Keep the browser open while agents work. Running tasks stop when the sandbox parks.

inputs.label: Repository to clone
inputs.help: Optional public repository, cloned once into /home/app/work. Choose that folder inside Agentbox.
